title: Idunn's Blessing - Keep Babies Forever!
description: Golden Apples now grant eternal youth to baby animals, keeping them small forever.
body:
**Ever wanted to keep your baby animals adorable forever?** Now you can! ❤️

This datapack introduces a mythological twist to Minecraft: **feeding a Golden Apple to any baby animal will grant them eternal youth**, keeping them as babies permanently.

Inspired by Norse mythology, where the goddess Idunn guarded golden apples that granted eternal youth to the gods. Just like in the myths, these rare golden fruits now have the power to stop aging.

![How it works? A baby chicken with a golden apple floating above it on the left, labeled 'FEED GOLDEN APPLE'. A clock icon and arrow in the center indicate a period of waiting. The right panel shows the same baby chicken next to a grown-up chicken, with green particles above the baby chicken, labeled 'FOREVER BABY!'.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/GwhcTx4x/images/6cb71cfc73f5ad9434ff360486f0e46df837d961.png)
**Feed a Golden Apple to any baby animal to keep it young forever.**
Works with all breedable animals!
